title: Still Want More? Here Are Some To Do's
coreMove: Use an opportunity search routine: stop weak habits, gather fresh inputs, question models, compare many deals, and make informed offers before attachment takes over.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader whose bank account leaks through familiar habits
exampleSpecs.stakes: a normal week will repeat the same cash flow unless one routine is interrupted
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show stop doing as a practical assessment of routine and cash flow

exampleSpecs.audience: a beginner seeking a proven model instead of private guessing
exampleSpecs.stakes: admiration can stay vague unless the learner asks about the process
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use a mentor model and process questions to reduce guesswork

exampleSpecs.audience: a buyer learning value through repeated deal search
exampleSpecs.stakes: one attractive listing can capture emotion before the market is compared
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show many offers and bargain shopping as judgment training

exampleSpecs.audience: a salaried worker checking a small daily leak
exampleSpecs.stakes: a harmless habit may block money for learning inputs
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show stop doing through an assessment of a recurring cash flow choice

exampleSpecs.audience: a side-hustle owner choosing between guessing and modeling
exampleSpecs.stakes: a good product may still fail if the operating process is invented alone
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show a proven model answering process questions

exampleSpecs.stakes: public bidding can turn a search routine into a performance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show deal search, markets, offers, and walking away from a weak bargain
